title: MeTube
descript: MeTube is a web UI for yt-dlp: paste a link, pick format and quality, and the video or audio is downloaded straight into a folder on your NAS - no terminal needed. It supports playlists and channels, shows live progress, keeps a download queue and history, and bundles yt-dlp updates in the image.
release_note: 1. First release: MeTube 2026.11.14 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. yt-dlp web UI with queue, history and format selection; downloads saved to the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). Paste URLs in the web UI; files land in DockerAppData/metubedocker/downloads. Downloads need outbound internet access from the NAS, and the sites you use may require login cookies (configure them in the UI settings). Plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.

zh-cn.descript: MeTube 是 yt-dlp 的网页界面：粘贴链接、选格式与清晰度，视频或音频就直接下载到 NAS 上的目录里，不用敲命令。支持播放列表与频道、实时进度、下载队列与历史，镜像里自带 yt-dlp 更新。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。在网页里粘贴 URL，文件落在 DockerAppData/metubedocker/downloads。下载需要 NAS 能访问外网，部分站点可能需要在界面设置里配置登录 Cookie。界面为纯 HTTP，暴露到公网前请配置带 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：基于 Docker Hub 的 MeTube 2026.11.14，以非 root 容器运行。yt-dlp 网页界面，带队列、历史与格式选择；下载文件保存在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: MeTube 是 yt-dlp 的網頁介面：貼上連結、選格式與清晰度，影片或音訊就直接下載到 NAS 上的目錄裡，不用敲指令。支援播放清單與頻道、即時進度、下載佇列與歷史，映像裡自帶 yt-dlp 更新。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。在網頁裡貼上 URL，檔案落在 DockerAppData/metubedocker/downloads。下載需要 NAS 能存取外網，部分站點可能需要在介面設定裡配置登入 Cookie。介面為純 HTTP，公開到互聯網前請配置帶 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 MeTube 2026.11.14，以非 root 容器運行。yt-dlp 網頁介面，帶佇列、歷史與格式選擇；下載檔案保存在應用資料目錄。

data_notes: `/downloads` (mounted from `DockerAppData/metubedocker/downloads`) holds the downloaded media and the queue database.
design_notes: **Runs as uid 1000.** The image detects the container user and starts as 1000.
**yt-dlp inside the image.** Downloads use the bundled binary; update the image to update yt-dlp.
limitations: - Only sites supported by yt-dlp work; some need login cookies.
- Downloads use the NAS's internet connection; large files fill the data folder.
- The UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
